scope: Conventional all-layer causal LM pretraining from random backbone initialization
parameter_comparison: Identical shared backbone and tokenizer; AD/EXP exactly match learned feature parameters and state. HH variants have their own explicit parameter/state budgets, including biases. FAVOR matrices are fixed buffers.

precision.backbone: BF16 autocast with FP32 master parameters
precision.loss: FLA Ascend fused linear cross entropy; no auxiliary loss

backend_choice: Before formal training, same-card reversed-order benchmarks found the CANN GEMM torch chunk backend 1.36-1.37x faster than ascend-hybrid at batch16, length1024 (AD m64 and HH m384), with 1-3 GiB greater peak allocation. Evidence: work/reproduction/backend_benchmark.json. The original draft is retained in work/protocol_drafts.
seed_scope: All three seeds use the same full 1.074B-token LR schedule. Seeds 29/47 stop at the common 104.858M-token milestone; seed 11 continues to 1.074B. Early milestone is explicitly an early-training comparison, not converged 100M-token training.
data_order: Random permutation of nonoverlapping 1024-target-token blocks, seed 85000+model_seed. No repeated target block within a run. Identical order for every method at a given seed.
selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoints; no method, seed, LR or token-budget selection using the test set
evaluation: Token-weighted NLL/PPL on held-out domains, length extension, new-domain text and associative recall; per-seed and paired-document statistics where applicable
limitations: Single seed at the final 1.074B-token budget; three seeds at the 104.858M-token milestone. Hardware throughput must be measured separately from concurrent quality jobs.
